verdict.rationale: Brex documents an official MCP server that lets AI assistants interact directly with a Brex account through natural language: managing expenses, looking up users, checking cards, reviewing banking transactions and tracking bills. It gives a concrete setup command (claude mcp add ... https://api.brex.com/mcp). Marketing also describes AI assistants that file expenses, write memos and fetch receipts for employees. Community remarks calling the AI features gimmicky are general skepticism, not a concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent corroboration of natural-language operation, a detailed list of which write actions the MCP server supports, and documentation of an in-product natural-language command interface beyond marketing copy.
